# ISO directory mapping fixtures

These small images exercise directory names and file data for the archive/disc
reader. The checked-in `.iso` files are the runtime fixtures; tests do not
need to install an image-generation utility. The `payload/` inputs and
`generate.sh` let a developer rebuild them with `genisoimage` 1.1.11 or a
compatible version.

All payload text and binary bytes were authored for this fixture; no external
sample image or third-party content is included. The binary files contain
short deterministic byte patterns, and the SHA-256 values below are for the
unpacked payload files.

## Images and expected paths

| Image | Filesystem extensions | Expected paths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images/iso9660-base.iso` | ISO9660, without Joliet or Rock Ridge | `README.TXT`, `CHECK.BIN` |
| `images/joliet-unicode.iso` | ISO9660 + Joliet | `说明-中文长文件名.txt`, `校验数据.bin` |
| `images/rockridge-long-path.iso` | ISO9660 + Rock Ridge | `目录层级一/目录层级二/this-is-a-deliberately-long-rock-ridge-filename.txt`, `目录层级一/目录层级二/payload-check.bin` |
| `images/udf-bridge.iso` | ISO9660 + Joliet + Rock Ridge + UDF bridge | `桥接目录/bridge-readme.txt`, `桥接目录/udf-check.bin` |
| `images/udf250-metadata.iso` | Synthetic UDF 2.50 metadata partition | `split.bin` (two extents), `sparse.bin` (2 MiB hole plus `TAIL`) |
| `images/large-listing.iso` | ISO9660 + Rock Ridge, remote-listing fixture | `000-padding.dat` (2 MiB), `video.mp4` (4 MiB; extent begins at sector 1049 / byte 2,148,352, after the padding file) |

`udf-bridge.iso` exercises bridge-format detection. `udf250-metadata.iso` is a
small synthetic parser fixture, not a commercial Blu-ray image. It has standard
BEA01/NSR03/TEA01 recognition sectors and a UDF 2.50 metadata partition. The
split file has two physical extents; the sparse file has a 2 MiB hole followed
by four stored bytes, so its logical length is larger than the 1 MiB image.

The descriptor builder is adapted from `golift.io/udf`'s image tests at
[`image_test.go` commit `4fae2a5`](https://github.com/golift/udf/blob/4fae2a5/image_test.go).
The generator retains that source's BSD 3-Clause notice. Regenerate the image
from the module root with:

```sh
cd internal/mountfs/testdata/disc/images
go run ../generate_udf250.go
```

The ISO fixtures are generated with `genisoimage` 1.1.11 or a compatible
version; the synthetic UDF fixture is generated by the Go program above.

## Rebuild

From this directory, run:

```sh
./generate.sh
```

The script normalizes source permissions and timestamps, then writes the
ISO9660/bridge images under `images/`. It sets a fixed volume creation date for the ISO
fixtures. `genisoimage` writes some UDF bridge metadata with its own generated
values, so compare that image by directory entries and file contents rather
than expecting its whole-image SHA-256 to remain byte-for-byte identical
across rebuilds.

Optional local inspection (not needed by tests):

```sh
isoinfo -d -i images/iso9660-base.iso
isoinfo -J -f -i images/joliet-unicode.iso
isoinfo -R -f -i images/rockridge-long-path.iso
7z l -slt images/joliet-unicode.iso
7z l -slt images/udf-bridge.iso
```

The installed `isoinfo` may not decode Joliet UCS-2 names with Chinese glyphs;
7-Zip can be used to confirm those names. The Rock Ridge `isoinfo -R` listing
shows the long names directly.
